detector_control.note: The known-present contradiction (doubled zero from grep -c || echo 0) was classified detector-failure before the corrected single-zero capture was trusted as silence.

invariants.statement: Partition counts must sum to the universe count (hit + miss = universe).
A subset count cannot exceed its superset (intersection <= universe).
A single run cannot report both 'all N PRs hit' and 'empty intersection'.
Each declared count must be a single integer, not a multi-line `grep -c pat || echo 0` blob.

invariants_declared_before_run.note: This set is the contract. It is loaded before any run output is inspected. A violation is a detector-failure; neither side of a contradiction is published as a finding.

pathology.description: grep -c prints 0 and exits 1 on no match, so `grep -c pat || echo 0` prints 0 then 0 again. A naive reporter treats the blob != '0' as 'all 7 PRs hit' and a 0 line as 'empty intersection', publishing both.

prior_measurements.question: Measured: one run reported 'all 7 PRs hit' AND 'empty intersection' simultaneously because `grep -c pat || echo 0` printed '0\n0'. Target: a post-processor that asserts declared invariants over a single run's own output (counts must sum, a subset cannot exceed its superset) and fails the RUN as a detector failure rather than reporting either number.

post_processor.message: DETECTOR-FAILURE: violated invariant mutex-all-hit-empty-intersection: claims ['all_hit', 'empty_intersection'] are mutually exclusive. A single run cannot report both 'all N PRs hit' and 'empty intersection'.
